scientific.integrity: The proof combines the published genus-preserving lift of every positive-rank divisor on a metric banana path with the standard specialization inequality for divisor rank. The two inequalities for gonality are reconstructed explicitly.
limitations: The simultaneous genus-preserving statement is proved only for metric banana paths.
The result is existential and does not classify all algebraic curves with the given skeleton.
No higher-rank gonality-sequence preservation is asserted.

title: Metric banana paths admit genus- and gonality-preserving algebraic lifts
